line: A long life can still end in PEACE, like a leaf going home: "落叶归根" (fallen leaves return to the roots). Thank your body.
credit: Chinese idiom · Jingde Record of the Lamp, c. 1004
line_br:
A long life can still
end in PEACE, like
a leaf going home:
"落叶归根" (fallen
leaves return
to the roots).
Thank your body.
